parole.motivo_incerta: Of uncertain origin; perhaps; modello unc/uncertain
parole.significato: A woodwind instrument consisting of a tube with a row of holes that produce sound through vibrations caused by air blow…
parole.testo: From Middle English fleute, floute, flote, from Old French flaute, fleüte, from Old Provençal flaüt, of uncertain origin. Perhaps ultimately from three possibilities: * Blend of Provencal flaujol (“flageolet”) + laüt (“lute”) * From Latin flātus (“blowing”), from flāre (“to blow”) * Imitative. Doubl
